name: Krusk
summary: At Tarren Mill, Krusk coordinates the search for his captured scouts and the Syndicate's relics. Sent by Warchief Thrall to investigate Durnholde Keep, he survived an ambush that scattered his team.

sections.title: A Mission Gone Wrong
sections.body: Krusk leads the effort from Tarren Mill after a failed strike at Durnholde Keep. Warchief Thrall sent him and a small team to scout Syndicate activity and recover relics tied to the fortress's grim past. The human outlaws were more entrenched and coordinated than expected, and an ambush inside the crumbling walls overwhelmed the orcish scouts. Krusk fought his way out. Drull and Tog'thar were taken captive and locked within the ruins, while Gol'dir, the expedition's leader, was moved to another Syndicate hold. Krusk now directs Horde forces to breach Durnholde, recover the lost items, and free his trapped comrades.

sections.title: Eyes on the Syndicate
sections.body: From Tarren Mill, Krusk tracks the Syndicate's movements in Hillsbrad. The fallen nobles of Alterac operate from Durnholde Keep, plotting against Horde outposts and their former Alliance brethren. Krusk watches leaders such as Lord Aliden Perenolde, hoping to break their command before they threaten the Horde's tenuous foothold in Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Krusk serves Warchief Thrall as an orc scout at Tarren Mill. He was sent to investigate Syndicate operations around Durnholde Keep and recover historic relics.

The Syndicate ambushed Krusk and his team inside Durnholde Keep. Krusk escaped, while Drull and Tog'thar were imprisoned in the ruins and Gol'dir, the expedition's leader, was taken to another Syndicate hold.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in Durnholde Keep?
faq.answer: The Horde is interested in Durnholde Keep because it holds personal and historical meaning for Warchief Thrall. Aedelas Blackmoore raised him there as a captive gladiator before Thrall led the orcish rebellion that razed the keep.
Krusk is outdoors at Tarren Mill, the Horde settlement in northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see Krusk carrying Warchief Thrall's interests into Lordaeron. He works to secure Durnholde's history and keep captured orcs from Syndicate hands.
As an orc, helping Krusk rescue his fellow scouts touches the honor and painful history of the internment camps. Durnholde is the fortress where Thrall broke his people's chains.
